children: On September 29, 2026, the company received a notice from Nasdaq that its common stock failed to meet the $1.00 minimum bid price for 30 consecutive business days. Xcel Brands has 180 days, until March 29, 2027, to regain compliance by achieving a closing bid of at least $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days, with potential additional time or delisting risk if not cured.
